scripts.watch: svelte-check --workspace ./src/js --tsconfig ../../tsconfig.svelte.json && tsc && cross-env BOLT_WATCH=true vite build --watch
scripts.test:release-safety: bun scripts/freesound-node-smoke.ts && bun scripts/cloud-library-smoke.ts && bun scripts/cloud-library-node-smoke.ts && bun scripts/metadata-save-smoke.ts && bun scripts/file-replacement-smoke.ts && bun scripts/sfx-assistant-smoke.ts && node scripts/favorites-smoke.mjs && bun run test:theme
scripts.build: rimraf dist && svelte-check --workspace ./src/js --tsconfig ../../tsconfig.svelte.json && tsc -p "tsconfig-build.json" && vite build
scripts.build:adobe:candidate: cross-env SOUNDDESIGNER_RELEASE_BUILD=true bun run build:adobe && bun scripts/artifact-audit.ts --prepare-adobe
scripts.build:resolve: rimraf resolve/dist && bun run check:resolve && bun run test:resolve && vite build --config resolve/vite.config.ts && bun build ./resolve/src/main/main.ts --outfile ./resolve/dist/native/main.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build ./resolve/src/main/preload.ts --outfile ./resolve/dist/native/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun ./resolve/scripts/assemble.ts && bun ./resolve/scripts/verify-artifact.ts
scripts.release:package: bun run test:audio && bun run test:search-tabs && bun run test:release-safety && cross-env SOUNDDESIGNER_RELEASE_BUILD=true bun run build && node scripts/package-release.mjs
scripts.installer:windows:build: bun run build:resolve && bun run release:package && cross-env SOUNDDESIGNER_INSTALLER_CANDIDATE=1 bun run installer:windows
scripts.installer:macos: bun run build:resolve && bun run release:package && cross-env SOUNDDESIGNER_INSTALLER_CANDIDATE=1 SOUNDDESIGNER_ZXP= bun run installer:macos:assemble
scripts.zxp: rimraf dist && svelte-check --workspace ./src/js --tsconfig ../../tsconfig.svelte.json && tsc -p "tsconfig-build.json" && cross-env ZXP_PACKAGE=true vite build
scripts.zip: rimraf dist && svelte-check --workspace ./src/js --tsconfig ../../tsconfig.svelte.json && tsc -p "tsconfig-build.json" && cross-env ZIP_PACKAGE=true vite build
